provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Reports a near miss: the event came to the brink and then did not happen, set up by もう少しで, 危なく, あやうく or a negative conditional (君が呼んでくれなければ寝過ごすとこだ). The sibling lane is the plain imminent reading, where the same 辞書形＋ところ schedules an event that really does occur (これから出るところだ). This near miss is usually told in the past, とこだった, filed as its own entry; the non-past だ here is live commentary.

examples.ruby: もう少[すこ]しで電車[でんしゃ]に乗[の]り遅[おく]れるとこだ。
examples.english: I came within a hair of missing my train.

examples.ruby: 君[きみ]が思[おも]い出[だ]させてくれなければ、約束[やくそく]をすっぽかすとこだ。
examples.english: If you hadn't reminded me, I'd have blown off the appointment.

examples.ruby: 一歩[いっぽ]間違[まちが]えば大[おお]けがをするところだ。
examples.english: One wrong step and you'd be badly hurt.
